description: This Java class handles commands to adjust fixed deposit transactions within the Fineract project. It implements the NewCommandSourceHandler interface and uses a service to perform the adjustment operation, with command details provided via JsonCommand.

classes.name: FixedDepositTransactionAdjustmentCommandHandler
classes.description: A service class handling fixed deposit transaction adjustment commands, wiring in the deposit account write platform service and processing adjustment commands transactionally.

methods.name: FixedDepositTransactionAdjustmentCommandHandler
methods.description: Constructor injecting the deposit account write platform service.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the adjustment command by extracting transaction ID and delegating to the deposit account service to perform the adjustment.
